A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the master equation for a weakly coupled system is solved exactly in the case that there is a single relevant conserved quantity.

the master equation can be solved exactly for a wide class of problems if the motion of the system is described by an Hamiltonian and if the heat-baths connect the quantum states of the system by nearest-neighbour transitions.
we have developed an effective theory of quantum systems coupled to reservoirs, which is able to describe quantum systems far from thermal equilibrium, but still in a weak coupling limit.
